application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
T1 – Mimosa (Albizia julibrissin)
Approximate dimensions: 8m height, 6m lateral spread
Proposed works: Crown reduction to address overextension on one section, removing approximately 2.5m of growth from the affected limbs only, retaining overall tree form. Proposed resultant dimensions: 7.5m height, 5m lateral spread.

T2 – Magnolia (Magnolia sp.)
Approximate dimensions: 8m height, 5m lateral spread
Proposed works: Modest crown reduction of 0.5–1m throughout to improve shape and maintain balanced form, retaining the natural character of the tree.

T3 – Bay Laurel (Laurus nobilis)
Approximate dimensions: 8m height, 5m lateral spread
Proposed works: Crown reduction of approximately 2m throughout to reshape the canopy and reintegrate overextended limbs, reducing weight on extended growth and improving overall structure. Proposed resultant dimensions: 6m height, 3m lateral spread.
